title.narrative: Medium-Size Cities Integrated Urban Development Project

description.narrative: The proposed PDO is to support the Borrower to: (1) improve access to selected urban infrastructure (including public spaces) and services in Participating Cities; and (2) to strengthen the institutional capacity of the Borrower’s relevant agencies to deliver andmanage local infrastructure.
